signIn.maintenancePlan: Maintenance-only plan · all of Shalimar Court
signIn.twoSites: Two sites · Towers: sales and construction · Plaza: maintenance only
signIn.society: Al-Noor Residency: an 80-flat society, setup and monthly billing

plan.intro: What {{organisation}}'s PropertyOS subscription includes, and the sites each module covers. Changes are made on request by a contract amendment; nothing changes here.
plan.includedHint: Everyone in your workspace works within these modules; each person sees the parts their role allows.
plan.notIncludedHint: These never appear in your workspace. To add one, ask your PropertyOS account manager.

home.subtitle: Your workspace as of {{date}}: the work your plan and role include.
home.areasHint: Limited by your organisation's plan and your role.
home.noAreas: Your role has no work areas in this plan yet. Ask your workspace administrator.
home.planHint: The modules your organisation has licensed.
home.planAdmin: You can see the full plan, with the sites each module covers.
home.planAsk: Your workspace administrator can see the full plan.
home.accessHint: The areas and sites your role lets you use.
home.plannedHint: Your plan includes maintenance. These screens are planned and not available in this prototype yet.

suspended.title: {{organisation}}'s workspace is suspended
suspended.body: Financial history stays available to read. Other work is paused until the workspace is reinstated; your administrator has the details.

invoices.intro: Invoices issued by {{organisation}} and what has been paid against them. This is financial history, so it stays available even while the workspace is suspended.
invoices.emptyBody: Try another search or payment status.

myAccess.intro: What you can use in {{organisation}}'s workspace, and on which sites. It follows your role and your organisation's licence.
myAccess.areasHint: Each area shows the sites it covers and what your role lets you do there.
myAccess.askAdmin: Need something that isn't listed? Ask your workspace administrator.

permissions.document.view: See documents of records you can open

hub.sessionNote: Kept for this sign-in only: signing out or switching identity clears this list. A record you can no longer open disappears from it.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Single keys work on this page when you are not typing. Ctrl+K still opens search everywhere.

search.title: Search everything
search.intro: Every kind of record you can open, in one place: leads, customers, units, projects, invoices, documents, templates and more. Records you cannot open are never shown or counted.
search.label: Search for
search.placeholder: A name, reference, unit, phone or file
search.hint: At least 2 characters. Results update as you type.
search.startBody: Type at least 2 characters, or open a record you used recently or marked as a favourite.
search.noneBody: Check the spelling or try a reference, a unit or a phone number. Only records you can open are searched.

recent.title: Recent records
recent.intro: The records you opened, newest first. Open one again in a click, or mark it as a favourite.
recent.clearEffect: Your list of recently opened records is emptied. The records themselves are not changed.
recent.noneBody: Records you open (a lead, a unit, a document …) appear here.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.intro: Records you marked with the star, up to {{limit}}. Use the star on any search result, recent record, task or document.
favourites.noneBody: Mark a record with the star to keep it one click away.

tasks.title: My tasks
tasks.intro: Your own work from every area you use, soonest first. Each task opens where the work is done.
tasks.noneBody: Only work on records you can open is listed and counted.

queue.title: Work queue
queue.intro: Your team’s open work within your projects and areas: follow-ups, visits, holds, expiring documents and approvals. Filter it and act directly.
queue.noneBody: Work on records outside your scope is not listed or counted.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.intro: What happened on the records you can open, newest first. Activity on records you cannot open is never shown.
activity.noneBody: Choose a longer period, or open a record to start working.

related.noDocuments: No documents on this record yet.
related.noneBody: Records you cannot open are not shown.

problems.favouritesFull: You have 50 favourites. Remove one to add another.
